_documentation.purpose: Declares production files under apps/web/src that ARE reachable through a non-static consumer knip cannot see (fs.readdirSync discovery, string-configured entry points, dynamic import() from instrumentation.ts, generator inputs). Declaring a file here removes it from the unreachable set so the guard stops flagging it.
_documentation.whenToUse: Only when a file is genuinely reachable at runtime but knip reports it as unused. If it is NOT reachable, wire it in or delete it instead — do not declare dead code alive.

entryShape.consumer: the exact non-static consumer that reaches it, e.g. 'instrumentation.ts dynamic import()' or 'lib/x/discovery.ts fs.readdirSync'
entryShape.reason: one line explaining why the consumer is invisible to static analysis
